title: Read repository instructions
details: Read AGENTS.md DESIGN_SYSTEM_GUIDE.md FILE_OWNERSHIP.md PRE_PUSH_CHECK.md and referenced START-HERE.md
acceptance_criteria: Every available instruction read; unavailable paths logged as BLOCKED

title: Run Graphify query
details: Ask graph for screen-route-flow-service-API-test relationships before broad source exploration
acceptance_criteria: Command exit/status and concise useful output recorded

title: Capture local Git baseline
details: Record branch full SHA local tags status and diff statistics without altering working tree
acceptance_criteria: Pre-existing dirty changes preserved and SHA recorded

title: Compare versions and release claims
details: Compare local pubspec README AGENTS tags and public release metadata
acceptance_criteria: Conflicting version/test/route claims listed with source evidence

title: Scan Dart files
details: Run scanner on the exact checkout and preserve outputs
acceptance_criteria: All discovered Dart files counted; regex limits stated

title: Index assets localization tests manifests
details: Run project surface inventory script without executing tests
acceptance_criteria: ARB/test/assets/config files accounted for and counts reconciled

title: Read route registry and constants
details: Reconcile GetPage declarations and named route constants with scanner candidates
acceptance_criteria: Every known declaration accounted for and unresolved dynamic routes recorded

title: Trace navigation call sites
details: Review named and direct navigation calls nested routes tabs and programmatic flows
acceptance_criteria: Dynamic routes and non-route screen entries are accounted for or blocked

title: Classify screen-like classes
details: Classify each candidate as route screen tab sub-screen dialog bottom-sheet component deprecated or unresolved
acceptance_criteria: No candidate silently discarded; classification reason stored

title: Inspect deep links and notifications
details: Inspect Android/iOS manifests notification routing QR links and universal/app links
acceptance_criteria: All found entry points mapped to route IDs or listed unresolved

title: Map auth and identity flows
details: Trace login OTP biometrics KYC/session/authorization conditions where present
acceptance_criteria: UI to controller/service/API/model/test path captured with evidence

title: Map all financial flows
details: Trace wallet balance transfer exchange deposit withdraw card bill payment QR and other actually discovered financial domains
acceptance_criteria: Financial side effect idempotency/fee/amount state and API boundaries documented

title: Map travel and service flows
details: Trace travel booking service support tickets notifications profile and every additional discovered domain
acceptance_criteria: All actually discovered user journeys represented

title: Trace page to state owner and services
details: Map screen to Controller/GetX binding/state to service/repository/API/model where possible
acceptance_criteria: No unsupported inferred edge marked confirmed

title: Index existing tests without running
details: Map unit widget integration screenshot and golden tests to screen/flow/requirement
acceptance_criteria: Existing test files indexed and untested routes clearly distinguished

title: Identify route and screen gaps
details: Find dangling routes unreachable screen candidates pages without documented entry/owners and duplicate patterns
acceptance_criteria: Each gap has evidence severity business impact and acceptance criteria

title: Identify UI-to-business gaps
details: Find CTA no-op fake success hard-coded financial values missing states and API contract drift where source proves it
acceptance_criteria: Findings cite actual file/line and uncertainty status

title: Identify financial/sensitive data surfaces
details: Map secret and PII handling areas without printing values and note logs/screenshots/offline queues concerns
acceptance_criteria: No secret values in evidence and findings are evidence-based

title: Map locale and RTL coverage
details: Inspect six locale ARBs formatting date/number/calendar and RTL-specific screen behavior
acceptance_criteria: Translation key counts do not substitute for semantic review

title: Populate evidence ledger
details: Record source SHA command/screen scenario artifact paths exit codes and limitations for findings
acceptance_criteria: Runtime verification and PASS status each have evidence

title: Validate route catalog schema
details: Run validator and resolve schema errors without marking unresolved content complete
acceptance_criteria: Zero schema errors; all warnings triaged

title: Publish discovery summary
details: Fill summary template with counts discrepancies blockers and ordered P0/P1 priorities
acceptance_criteria: Counts source-mapped/runtime-verified/tested/blocked differ explicitly

title: Prepare phase 2 ownership assignments
details: Assign future edit scopes only after discovery and file ownership are reconciled
acceptance_criteria: No file has overlapping unapproved ownership; no source edits in phase 1

title: Confirm no remote side effects
details: Confirm no push/tag/release/deploy/workflow trigger and no real financial action took place
acceptance_criteria: All are explicitly YES and backed by command/evidence review
